oneSentenceStory: The customer reviews their 63% progress toward First Home Savings knowledge and accesses educational modules to deepen their understanding.
customerSituation: Customer has completed 1,250 of 2,500 units toward their First Home Savings Knowledge goal and wants to track further learning milestones.
storyTension: The customer needs structured, non-timed educational milestones to reach their target without artificial pressure.
customerResolution: Engaging with clear progress metrics and completing financial literacy quizzes at their own pace.
